text: How Good and Pleasant Is UnityA Song of Ascents. Of David.Behold, how good and how pleasant it isFor brothers to dwell together in unity!
It is like the good oil upon the head,Coming down upon the beard,Aaron’s beard,Coming down upon the edge of his robes.
It is like the dew of HermonComing down upon the mountains of Zion;For there, Yahweh commanded the blessing—life forever.
